jsx.readme:
## Auth

`useAuth()` (from `src/auth/AuthContext.jsx`) talks to the exact JWT contract the backend composer's `auth-jwt*` modules expose: `POST /auth/{register,login,refresh,logout}`, `GET /auth/me`. The access token is kept in memory only; the refresh token is an httpOnly cookie the browser sends automatically (`credentials: "include"` in `src/auth/authApi.js`). `LoginForm` / `RegisterForm` / `AuthStatus` in `src/components/` are ready to drop into any page.

Set `VITE_API_URL` in `.env` to point at your backend (defaults to `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`, matching the backend composer's default).
